name: carrotcap-cli
description: CARROTCAP CLI terminal app with split panes, folder sidebar, and quick CLI launchers.
author: CarrotCap

scripts.prebuild-check: node -e "const p=require.resolve('@homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch');const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const root=path.join(path.dirname(p),'..');const candidates=[path.join(root,'build','Release'),path.join(root,'prebuilds')];const found=candidates.find(d=>fs.existsSync(d)&&listFiles(d).some(f=>f.endsWith('.node')));function listFiles(d){const out=[];function walk(x){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(x,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=path.join(x,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(f);else out.push(f)}}walk(d);return out}if(!found){console.error('[carrotcap] FATAL: pty native binary missing under '+root+'. Reinstall: npm install');process.exit(1)}console.log('[carrotcap] pty native OK: '+found)"
scripts.dist:mac: npm run prebuild-check && electron-builder --mac dmg pkg
scripts.postinstall: echo [carrotcap] Using @homebridge/node-pty-prebuilt-multiarch (prebuilt binaries, no compile needed).
